connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.intro: Your own agents. Each acts as you, in the workspaces you choose, and its changes show in version history.
connect.webNeedsPublic: Claude on the web needs this node at a public https address. An administrator can set that up under Remote access.
connect.webNeedsPublicAdmin: Claude on the web needs this node at a public https address. Set that up under <link>Remote access</link>.
connected.title: Connected agents
connected.intro: These agents act with your access. Revoke one to end its access.
connected.empty: You haven’t connected any agents yet.
